fusions.name: Loose Thread
fusions.desc: A bite that pulls a thread loose, dealing 4 damage and leaving the target 10% easier to wound for 5 seconds.

fusions.name: Rug Pull
fusions.desc: You pull the rug out from under every enemy within 3 tiles, dealing 11 damage and stunning each for 0.8 seconds.

fusions.name: Rag Nest
fusions.desc: Builds a nest of rags around you that absorbs the next 18 damage and holds for 6 seconds, and raises your armour by 6% while it holds. You move 15% faster for 3 seconds afterward.

fusions.name: Padded Lining
fusions.desc: When you are hurt by anything but fire, you gain a shield worth 10% of your maximum health for 4 seconds. Once every 10 seconds. You also have 5% more dodge chance.
